summary.text: Mike Coffey was sworn in as State Representative for the 95th District in the Illinois House in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: The legislature biography describes him as a small business owner who founded the restaurant Papa Frank's and earlier managed his family's Springfield restaurant, Saputo's.
It says he has served on the board of the Springfield Metropolitan Exposition and Auditorium Authority since 1997 and has chaired it since 2005.
